description: Poll a background job by id until status is succeeded or failed. A failed job carries its user-safe error reason — show it to your user. Jobs run on a background worker that claims queued work on a schedule, so a job sitting at "queued" (0 attempts) for the first few minutes is NORMAL, not a fault — keep polling every ~30–60s and reassure the user it is being prepared; do NOT report this as an error or a Datavrn bug. Only if it is still "queued" well past a few minutes should you tell the user it is taking longer than usual.

job_id.description: The job id returned by generate_schedule_iii.
